organization.name: Scarborough Good Neighbours Drop-In
organization.description:
Drop-In hours (all are welcome), with sit-down/take-out meals — Thursday and Friday, 9:30 a.m.–4:00 p.m.

The Hans Brenninkmeyer Food for Families program — Wednesday 2–4 pm, and Friday 9:30 am–4:00 p.m. (emergency food for families with children; appointment required)

Seniors’ Day with social and craft activities, plus a food bank (note we are not affiliated with the Daily Bread Food Bank) — Wednesday, 9:30 a.m.–4:00 p.m.

requirements.eligibility: People experiencing homelessness, refugees, newcomers (focus on families)
